solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**collaborate**" means to work jointly with others or together, especially in an intellectual endeavor. (सहयोग करना)
 
• In the context of the passage, it **emphasizes** the need for collective action and cooperation among all members of society to tackle climate change effectively.
 
• The other options: "**colonize**," "**congregate**," and "**commemorate**" do not align with the context of working together as a society to address a common issue.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** As the consequences of climate change become more evident, it is imperative that we collaborate__ as a society to protect our planet for future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Colonize (उपनिवेश बनाना)**: To establish a colony in or on, or to settle among and establish control over the indigenous people of an area.
 
• **Congregate (इकट्ठा करना)**: To gather into a crowd or mass.
 
• **Commemorate (स्मरण करना)**: To recall and show respect for someone or something in a ceremony.
